text:
harper: thinking of a low-key, phone-free porch hang saturday afternoon — tea, boardgames, and a tiny book swap. anyone in? :books:

noah: count me in. what time? i can bring mint tea and my travel chess set.

ivy: love that. saturday 3pm works. i'll bring a small mystery paperback for the swap.

harper: 3pm then. bring a cup and a blanket if you want. no cameras pls, just cozy vibes. :sparkling_heart:

sam: can i bring my weird card game? fair warning: rules are fuzzy.

ivy: fuzzy rules are encouraged. :laughing:

noah: also curious — should we make it BYO-snack or sign-up? small things only (no big greasy trays).

harper: BYO-snack pls, label for allergies. i'll put a tiny sign on the porch about shoes-off and no smoking.

ops-bot: reminder: personal gatherings in shared yards should follow the community guidelines. RSVP optional: https://intranet/events

sam: voted yes. i'll bring hummus + cut veggies.

harper: perfect. if rain we pivot to sunday 11am brunch at the cafe next door. will post an update SAT 10am. see you! :tea:
